# Code of Conduct

## The short version

Be decent. Assume the person you are talking to is trying to help.

## Expected behaviour

- Be respectful of differing viewpoints and experience levels.
- Give and accept constructive feedback gracefully. Review comments are about the code.
- Take responsibility for mistakes, apologise to those affected, and move on.

## Unacceptable behaviour

- Harassment, insults, or personal or political attacks.
- Sexualised language or imagery, or unwelcome sexual attention.
- Publishing others' private information without permission.
- Any other conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional
  setting.

## Scope

This applies in all project spaces — issues, pull requests, discussions — and when
representing the project publicly.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behaviour to the maintainer by opening a private security advisory or
contacting them through their GitHub profile. Reports will be reviewed and handled
discreetly. Maintainers may edit, remove or reject contributions that violate this policy,
and may ban a contributor for repeated or serious violations.

This document is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org),
version 2.1.
